subject: Converge: Security review slate for Peregrine Systems
messages:
From: Ethan Willis <ewillis@peregrine-sys.com>

Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@peregrine-sys.com>, Luis Gomez <luis.gomez@peregrine-sys.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security review request — Peregrine / Redwood

Jordan —

Thanks for following up. We want to lock in a formal security review session before the pilot kickoff. Key attendees from our side will be Priya (security lead), Luis (platform engineering), and procurement (TBD). High-level asks:
- Walkthrough of data flow and isolation controls for private deployment
- SOC 2 scope and attestation details
- Retention & access logging (audit log retention windows)

Our preferred window is next week in the mornings PST (Nov 9—11). Can you confirm who from Redwood needs to attend (SE + security + AE)? Also, we may need a brief pre-read to circulate to procurement.

—Ethan

Ethan Willis
Director of Cloud Engineering | Peregrine Systems
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Willis <ewillis@peregrine-sys.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Security review request — Peregrine / Redwood

Ethan — thanks, and great to hear the preferred window. Attendees from Redwood: me (AE), Ava (SE, will do architecture and data flow), Marissa (Security & Compliance), and Ben (procurement lead for contract/pricing nuance).

Proposed plan:
1) 60-minute live review (cover architecture, SOC 2 scope, logging/retention, Q&A)
2) Circle back with a short procurement packet (SLA excerpt, data retention table, pricing addendum)
3) Post-session action items with target SLAs and evidence checklist

Availability (PST mornings):
- Mon Nov 9: 09:00 — 11:00 (Ava has a customer at 10:30)
- Tue Nov 10: 09:30 — 12:00
- Wed Nov 11: 08:30 — 10:00

Marissa, can you confirm if a 60-minute session is enough to cover the SOC 2 items + logging deep-dive, or should we plan 90? Also attaching the pre-read packets we usually send (SOC2 summary + network diagram).

Attachments: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf, redwood_network-diagram.png

Thanks — I’ll hold tight for confirmation and will send a calendar hold once we pick a slot.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Re: Security review request — Peregrine / Redwood

Jordan / team —

60 minutes should be fine for a high-level walkthrough and to answer initial questions, but if they want an audit-evidence deep-dive (e.g., log-store retention, SIEM integrations, tenant isolation tests) we may need 90. Suggest we keep a 60-minute primary session and offer an optional 30-minute follow-up for technical deep-dive.

One ask: can Peregrine share any specific compliance questions or a checklist in advance so we can pull exact evidence? A single procurement doc or questionnaire works. That will speed the session.

I’ll be on the Nov 10 morning window.

—Marissa

Marissa Cole
Senior Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
